newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - May 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - May 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 80 companies from Gulf Arab states and 110 firms from the European Union will participate in a two-day meeting in Riyadh on May 20.
- Health minister signs maintenance contracts worth 88 million riyals.
- Around 500,000 tourists from Gulf Arab states are expected to visit Asir region this year.
- Saudi Arabia to send aid to help victims of Iran earthquake.
- Agriculture and water minister announces the setting up of a 500 million riyal agricultural marketing company.
